answer: Locks are recorded in quill, expire in zephyr, and thread lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 152 aliases therefore needs 168 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1551 identities would post 3270 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
